name: Inva Tech Pharma
old_description: InvaTech Pharmaceuticals LLC is a specialty pharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures and markets generic prescription products. InvaTech has an experienced team of dedicated, uncompromising professionals who ensure excellence at every phase of product development through delivery to the market. Our passion lies in serving our partners better than anyone else. We meet and try to exceed every deadline and every industry regulation.
about:
InvaTech Pharmaceuticals LLC is based in East Brunswick, New Jersey, where it operates as a specialty pharmaceutical company dedicated to the development, manufacture, and marketing of generic prescription products. The company describes itself as research-driven and focused on the generic pharmaceutical industry.

InvaTech’s core activities span the full product lifecycle from development through to market delivery, all conducted under Current Good Manufacturing Practice (CGMP) standards. The firm highlights its “state of the art facilities” and technical management capabilities, offering specialised bespoke solutions tailored to partner needs. Specific details on facility size, headcount, or production volumes are not disclosed.

The company serves the generic pharmaceutical industry, positioning itself as a partner to other firms seeking value-oriented solutions. Its website emphasizes a global reach, stating it helps “partners across the world,” though no individual customers or therapeutic areas are named.

InvaTech says its differentiation lies in an experienced team that “ensures excellence at every phase of product development through delivery to the market,” a commitment to meeting or exceeding every deadline and regulation, and a passion for serving partners better than anyone else.
